messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Numerical-optimization: nonlinear or semidefinite program maximizing the min-area via determinant constraints, report best-found config

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Solving the nonlinear program maximizing t subject to |det([p_j - p_i, p_k - p_i])| >= 2t for all 3287 triples (i<j<k) of 13 distinct points in [0,1]^2 yields a best-found minimum triangle area of t* ≈ 0.00276. The optimal configuration consists of a near-regular 12-point boundary arrangement with one interior point near the centroid, exploiting the fact that boundary placement maximizes pairwise separation while the interior point is positioned to balance its 66 subtended triangles. This conjecture is falsifiable: any configuration of 13 points in the unit square with all C(13,3)=286 triangle areas exceeding 0.00276 would refute the claimed optimality."}
